page.description: NethSecurity 8.8.0 for x86-64: compare the combined EFI disk image, download the official image, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: An open-source Linux firewall built on OpenWrt by the Nethesis/NethServer project, managed from a web interface and shipped as one raw disk image for x86-64 machines.
pros: Per-release SHA-256 sums and a CycloneDX SBOM are published next to the image.
One image covers bare metal, USB install and virtual machines.
Firewall, MultiWAN, VPN and threat protection in a web UI on top of OpenWrt.
The publisher labels each release supported, limited or end of life.
cons: x86-64 only: no ARM or router-board images.
A useful setup needs two network interfaces.
Writing the image under Windows is not recommended by the publisher.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for NethSecurity; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the .img.gz to a USB stick or straight to the target disk with dd; boot it and run ns-install to install onto the internal disk. Writing erases the target device, and the default LAN address 192.168.1.1 can collide with an existing network.

editions.name: x86-64 combined EFI image
editions.description: Raw disk image with the combined EFI layout for bare metal and virtual machines.
editions.usbNote: 83 MB gzipped image. Write it with dd or any image writer; the publisher documents both a direct disk write and a bootable USB stick.

requirements.note: Recommended: 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, and an extra disk for logs and persistent data.
